title: Targets, Discs, and Planes
description: Large-format collage integrating compact discs, concentric target rings, top-down warplane silhouettes, and a central framed drawing panel with orange flower motifs and geometric symbols. Red ribbon stripes, blue tape, a chess pawn, and an american football appear among densely layered paper and mixed-media elements.
composition: central framed panel flanked by dense layered zones
